name: t00-hud-hidden
js: (async () => { const b = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-hud'); if (b && !document.body.classList.contains('film')) { b.click(); document.body.classList.add('film'); } await (window.CITY.waterEdgesReady || null); })()

name: ward-deck-walk-nameboard-midday
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,r=C.waterfrontIslandArrivals,E=C.ISLAND_ARRIVAL_ESTIMATES;const d=r.layout.docks.ward;const x=d.deckAnchor[0],z=d.deckAnchor[1];a.selectMode('person');a.teleportTo(x,z,0);const g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person');if(!(Math.abs(g-E.deckTop)<0.05))throw Error('ward walker ground '+g+' != deck '+E.deckTop);const s=C.islandArrivalSurfaceAt(x,z);if(!s||s.dockId!=='ward')throw Error('ward surface sampler mismatch');const f=d.boardFacing;a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x+f[0]*7,E.deckTop+1.55,z+f[1]*7],look:[x,E.deckTop+1.85,z],fov:50});return {dock:'ward',teleportGround:g,deckTop:E.deckTop,boardFacing:f};})()

name: arrivals-check-enabled
js: (()=>{const C=window.CITY;const r=C.waterfrontIslandArrivals;if(!C.waterfrontIslandArrivalsEnabled||!r)throw Error('island arrivals disabled');const s=r.stats;const W=(x,z)=>!!C.waterAt(x,z);if(s.docks!==3)throw Error('expected 3 docks, got '+s.docks);if(s.piers!==3)throw Error('expected 3 decks, got '+s.piers);if(s.nameBoards!==3)throw Error('name boards incomplete');if(!s.connectorsRendered||s.connectorsRendered<6)throw Error('missing real connectors '+s.connectorsRendered);for(const d of Object.values(r.layout.docks)){const a=d.deckAnchor;if(W(a[0],a[1]))throw Error(d.id+' deck anchor is water');const surf=C.islandArrivalSurfaceAt(a[0],a[1]);if(!surf||surf.h!==C.ISLAND_ARRIVAL_ESTIMATES.deckTop)throw Error(d.id+' surface mismatch');}const before=C.waterfrontIslandArrivalsEnabled;C.waterfrontIslandArrivalsEnabled=false;const g=C.islandArrivalSurfaceAt(r.layout.docks.centre.deckAnchor[0],r.layout.docks.centre.deckAnchor[1]);C.waterfrontIslandArrivalsEnabled=before;if(g!==null)throw Error('surface not gated when disabled');console.log('[arrivals-check] '+JSON.stringify({docks:s.docks,piers:s.piers,connectors:s.connectorsRendered,wood:s.woodConnectors,atlas:s.nameAtlas,triangles:s.triangles}));})()
